title: Timeband focus profiles and legend summarization workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large time-series charts with many series create noisy legends and slow render on low-power devices. Current behavior shows full series list and dense numeric totals, which hurts readability for quick troubleshooting and increases DOM size for screen readers.

Goal: Design a lightweight "timeband focus" interaction and a summarization workflow for legends and tooltips that reduces cognitive load, preserves accessibility semantics, and offers progressive disclosure for heavy datasets. The feature should work across canvas and DOM fallbacks, respect design tokens for spacing/color, and provide clear a11y announcements for keyboard and screen reader users.

Scope: design system tokens alignment, legend compact mode, focus band visual treatment on time-axis, tooltip summarization rules, a11y narration phrasing, small-screen/low-power fallbacks, and handoff artifacts for engineering implementation (acceptance criteria + interaction spec).
acceptance_criteria: Compact legend mode that collapses >6 series into grouped summaries with a count; clicking expands inline without opening a modal
Timeband focus: drag-to-select band that dims non-focused series and exposes aggregated metrics in the legend summary
a11y: keyboard-only users can create and adjust timeband using shift+arrow keys, with ARIA live region announcing start/end times and aggregated values

Performance: DOM nodes for legend reduce by at least 60% on >20-series charts in DOM fallback; canvas path uses GPU-friendly compositing with no UI jank under 1200ms for 1M datapoints (SLO target provided to ENG)
Design tokens: spacing, radii, and color semantics documented and mapped to existing token names; no new raw colors
Responsive: on narrow viewports the legend collapses into a summary pill with accessible expand control
Handoff: Figma file with interaction states, a small prototype, and a PR template describing edge cases delivered to ENG-19755
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created after sync with Platform PM. Sketches attached for two summarization patterns (count-based and group-by-tag). Requested engineering feasibility check for keyboard timeband controls.

2026-03-11 Marco Rivera: Reviewed sketches; prefer count-based summarization initially. Requested we define exact keyboard mappings and ARIA messages. Noted potential conflict with current tooltip hover behavior—added ENG dependency.

2026-03-12 Leah Kim (Accessibility): Suggested using role=region with aria-label for focus band and an aria-live polite region for aggregated metric announcements. Also suggested simplifying phrasing to avoid numeric overload for screen reader users.

2026-03-13 Priya Desai (Performance): Ran quick sampling on a prototype canvas render; large-series mode needs batching of DOM updates for legend; recommended limiting DOM list render to visible subset and virtualize remainder. Added performance acceptance metric for engineering.
2026-03-14 Marco Rivera: Updated visuals in Figma (version v3). Attached token mapping table and proposed CSS variables. Ready for design review tomorrow.
notes: Decision: implement 'count-based' collapsed legend as default, with optional 'group-by-tag' expansion in later cycle
Trade-off: collapsing reduces discoverability for low-frequency series; mitigation: include 'recently-changed' badge and direct search within expanded legend
Engineering ask: ENG-19755 to provide a 'virtualized-list' helper for legends and an aria-live hook for aggregated announcements
Follow-ups: create small usability test with 6 participants (PM to own), and include keyboard-only scenarios in QA checklist
